collegeFullAddress: Department of Management Sciences (PUMBA), SPPU Main Campus, Ganeshkhind Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411007
collegeInfo: PUMBA is one of the premier B-schools in western India, known for its rigorous curriculum, stellar placements, low fees, government affiliation, and a vibrant campus at the heart of Savitribai Phule Pune University. PUMBA offers full-time and executive management programs, as well as doctoral research.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: As per Government of Maharashtra norms for reserved and EWS categories.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply through state scholarship portal and submit documents in the college office.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Savitribai Phule Pune University Merit Scholarship
scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Top performers in the first year of MBA; based on CGPA.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Awarded automatically based on academic records.

events.eventFullDescription: Dhruv is PUMBA’s flagship annual fest with case competitions, B-plan contests, quizzes, cultural programs, sporting events, and guest talks by industry stalwarts. The festival draws participants from B-schools and universities across India.
Showcasing the musical and artistic talents of PUMBA students, Symphony includes band performances, dance shows, art installations, and open mic nights.
A platform for interaction with HR leaders and alumni to discuss workforce trends, leadership, digital HR, and career trajectories, including panel discussions and workshops.
A series of events, case competitions and speaker sessions focused on the world of finance, analytics, banking, and investment management.

infrastructure.infraDescription: PUMBA's heritage-rich campus within SPPU features a green academic environment, modern classrooms, a large digital library, computer and analytics labs, dedicated placement cell, amphitheatre, hostels, sports grounds, and a state-of-the-art auditorium. Cafeteria, health center, and student club space available.
